models.title: ADAC Rescue Helicopter
models.note: Supplied GLB has geometry and a plain material, with no image textures or source licence/creator metadata.

changes: Game adaptations: simplified geometry, metre-scale axis alignment, wheel/rotor groups, converted materials, lower detail meshes and rendered preview images. Later repairs: material-role corrections, duplicate/degenerate face removal, more detailed rescue geometry, complete rotor grouping and an inferred yellow rescue finish; the supplied rescue asset has no authored image textures.
